layout.row_major: each matrix is stored row by row (numpy C order); wte is (vocab, n_embd)

vocabulary.note: char i of chars has id i; bos_id is the padding and boundary token

corpus.document_order: names.txt shuffled with random.seed(42) (Python 3 random.shuffle); the first 2000 are explorations/apl/reference/dzaima/docs.txt, which matched: True
corpus.length_meaning: LEN = 1 + chars = number of (input, target) pairs in the row

initial_parameters.source: explorations/apl/reference/dzaima/w/<name>.txt in layout order, rows in file order, high minus (U+00AF) for negatives
